Description: Athletics is used to determine a merc's endurance and ability to perform constitution-related feats, testing their heart and lungs more than their raw strength.

When the merc attempts to harm or otherwise attack someone or something, they'll use the Attack Circumstance. Dexterity Attacks are used for ranged or light-weight weapons, such as crossbows, handguns, and rapiers.
When the merc attempts to harm or otherwise attack someone or something, they'll use the Attack Circumstance. Vigor Attacks are used for heavy weapons, such as greatbows or colossal swords.
When a merc applies their wits and intellect, they'll use the Clever Circumstance, which applies their resourcefulness and intelligence.
Finesse is used when a merc wishes to utilize their dextrousness in a concentrated fashion with their fingers rather than their whole body. It reflects fine motor skills.
Grace is the application of the dextrousness of one's body, allowing a mercenary to effectively perform acrobatic maneuvers or move without stepping on creaking wooden boards.

Cognitive Intuition reflects a merc's ability to quickly apply their own knowledge in a given situation. It is a merc's ability to make an educated guess or come to a conclusion with minimal information.
Social Intuition is a merc's ability to determine what others are thinking and feeling, which informs a merc what they should or shouldn't say... or whether they should say anything at all.
When a merc scans a room, crowd or other space to pick out something out of the ordinary, they will use the Notice Circumstance. This is a broad search rather than a refined one.

A dexterous performance is one's ability not just to be acrobatic, but to do so with flair. Performative Dexterity is used when a merc is dancing or pulling off stunts rather than mere graceful movement.
A merc will apply the Performance Wile Circumstance when they are pretending to be someone else, putting on a show, or otherwise trying to distract, imitate, or impress.
The Power Circumstance is used by a Merc to lift heavy object, break free of powerful bindings, or perform other impressive feats of strength.
The Vigor Presence Circumstance is used to intimidate and impose with a merc's mere stature and the space they take up in a room.
A merc will use their Presence Wile Circumstance when they are utilizing the strength of their personality to accomplish a task.
The Resist Circumstance is used to avoid effects that target a particular attribute of a merc. This resistance protects a merc's mind.
The Resist Circumstance is used to avoid effects that target a particular attribute of a merc. This resistance allows a merc to quickly dodge out of the way of danger.
The Resist Circumstance is used to avoid effects that target a particular attribute of a merc. This resistance allows a merc to withstand powerful effects on their body.
The Resist Circumstance is used to avoid effects that target a particular attribute of a merc. This resistance guards a merc against effects that target their sense of self.
The Search Circumstance allows a merc to sift through a small area looking for something specific. This may be used to find information in a book, locate a tripwire, or find a hidden passage.
Whether trying to deceive or persuade, a merc will use Speech when trying to convince someone of something.
Spells require specific statistics to use; mercs with this Circumstance will have an easier time casting spells that use Cognition.
